Nidoran♀

Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Nidoran♀ is a Poison-type Poison Pin Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 7 kg. It evolves into Nidorina. Its highest base stat is HP (55), with a base stat total of 275.
